fullDescription: Lumina Interactive is a high-contrast, tech-forward design system optimized for immersive digital experiences, SaaS landings, and creative portfolios. It features a deep dark mode base (#020617) punctuated by high-saturation neon accents in Magenta (#f967fb), Cyan (#06b6d4), and Lime (#a3e635). The aesthetic combines brutalist oversized typography with delicate glassmorphism and 3D interactive elements. Key visual markers include geometric grid overlays, animated multi-stop gradients, and pulsating neon glows, creating a sensory, futuristic atmosphere suitable for gaming, fintech, or advanced technology sectors.
prompt:
## Resumo
A bold, dark-themed immersive design system utilizing interactive 3D elements, vibrant neon accents, and oversized 'Cabinet Grotesk' typography to create a high-energy, futuristic user interface.

## Estilo Visual
Create a design with a background of #020617. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk' for display text (Weight 900, Uppercase, -0.05em tracking) and 'Space Grotesk' for body text. Primary colors: Neon Magenta (#f967fb), Neon Cyan (#06b6d4), and Neon Lime (#a3e635). Implement a background grid using 1px lines of Magenta at 5% opacity spaced every 50px. UI elements should use a 'glass-card' style: background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter blur(20px), and border 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1). Interactive elements must have a 'neon-border' effect: 1px solid color with a matching 15px-20px box-shadow glow. Use a 3-stop linear gradient (#f967fb, #06b6d4, #a3e635) with a 4s 'gradientShift' animation for primary headlines.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
Fixed-width header with 24px/32px padding. Left: Brand logo using a white square rotated 45 degrees containing a black icon, paired with 3xl font-black text. Center: Nav links in 12px font, 0.3em tracking, all-caps. Right: 'Get In Touch' button with 2px Magenta border, no fill, transitioning to full Magenta fill on hover.

### Hero Section
Centered layout with high vertical padding (80px-120px). Top: Small badge with a Cyan pulsing dot and 0.4em letter spacing. Middle: Oversized headline (11rem) with negative leading (0.8), second line using an animated neon gradient. Bottom: Max-width 3xl paragraph in light font weight (300). Buttons: Dual-CTA setup. Primary: Lime green solid background with #a3e635 glow, 4px lift on hover. Secondary: Glass-card with Play icon in a magenta-hover circle.

### Interaction Layer
A background layer containing a 3D canvas (three.js) rendering reactive tubes in magenta, cyan, and lime. The canvas must respond to mouse movements and clicks, changing color spectrums on user interaction.

### Footer
Full-width with 48px padding and a top border (white/5%). Background is black/40% with backdrop-blur. Left: Interaction protocol card containing an animated magenta cursor icon and micro-text instructions. Right: Social media grid with 56x56px glass cards that change color (Magenta/Cyan/Lime) and remove blur on hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Vibrant Gradient Text — Animated multi-color headline text.
Apply a linear-gradient(90deg, #f967fb, #06b6d4, #a3e635). Set background-size to 200% auto. Use -webkit-background-clip: text and -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent. Animate with 'gradientShift' 4s linear infinite to create a flowing color effect.

### Neon Status Badge — Small pill-shaped indicator for 'active' states.
Padding 8px 16px. Background: glass-card. Left-border: 4px solid #06b6d4. Contains a 8px circle with background #06b6d4 and an animation: drop-shadow pulsing from 2px to 10px Cyan glow every 2 seconds.

### Interactive Interaction Card — Footer element explaining UI controls.
Padding 16px, background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), border: 1px solid #f967fb. Box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(249, 103, 251, 0.4). Icon: #f967fb with pulse animation. Text: 10px uppercase tracking-widest for labels, 12px white/60% for descriptions.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain strict uppercase for all headers and navigational labels. MUST NOT use standard rounded corners; use sharp corners or very subtle 2px-4px radii. MUST use letter-spacing: 0.2em or higher for all text smaller than 14px to ensure legibility against dark backgrounds. MUST ensure all glassmorphic elements have a distinct 1px border to separate from the 3D background.

style.description: The style is defined by a 'Neon Brutalist' aesthetic. Typography pairings use 'Cabinet Grotesk' (Black weight, 900) for high-impact headings and 'Space Grotesk' for functional UI elements. The color palette is strictly dark (#020617) with neon-reactive highlights. UI components utilize glassmorphism (20px blur) and thin neon borders (1px) with corresponding outer glows. Motion is characterized by 'gradientShift' animations and pulsing 'pulseGlow' effects on status indicators.
